text:
无语........OpenAI又出来号召大家搞慢研发了😅

昨天， @OpenAI  首席科学家Jakub Pachocki发表了一篇名为《Perplexity and Intelligence》的文章，呼吁全球主要 AI 实验室共同制定研发速度限制。

Sam Altman随后转发，称这是OpenAI最近发布的最重要的文章之一，并公开支持这一提议。

他们希望各家AI公司约定一个共同的能力上限，在人类具备足够的AI理解和监控能力之前，承诺不继续突破这个上限。

这次OpenAI还拿出了一个相当有意思的东西：内部模型从GPT-3.5至今的预训练Loss数据。

Jakub 认为，衡量 AI 智能水平的一个重要指标就是 Perplexity（困惑度），简单来说，就是模型预测下一个 Token的能力，数值越低，说明模型的预测能力越强。

根据OpenAI公布的内部数据：
GPT-3.5的Log-Perplexity约为0.99，GPT-4降到了0.91。
当这一数值降到0.8以下时，模型开始在数学、网络安全等领域展现出突破性的能力。
而OpenAI预计，当这一数值进一步降至 0.68～0.7 时，模型可能再次涌现出我们今天还无法预知的能力。

真正让他们担忧的，是AI开始参与AI自身的研发。
Jakub提到，当OpenAI的模型达到约0.76的水平时，它已经能够连续解决一些研究人员思考了很久的数学问题。

他认为，最快到2027年，类似的变化就可能发生在AI预训练算法研究中。
届时AI可能会帮助人类连续发现新的训练方法，让模型能力的提升进一步加速。

问题是，安全研究和监控技术跟不上这种速度。

所以OpenAI这次的提议大家先建立一套共同的能力衡量标准，再约定研发上限。
只有当我们能够更好地理解、监控AI的行为时，才能继续突破这些限制。

当然OpenAI自己也承认，困惑度很难直接跨公司比较，更无法完整衡量推理等能力。

现在OpenAI开始尝试把这件事变成一个可以量化、可以共同遵守的行业规则。

只是，在一个所有人都在争夺最强模型的行业里，大家能否真的达成一致，以及谁愿意先踩刹车，恐怕才是最困难的问题。

author: AlphaSeeker21
quoted_text:
Why do HEPH machines use USDG, not ETH?

A robot doesn't speculate. It pays for electricity, parking, compute and data, and all of those are priced in dollars. Here's why that matters.

1. LIMITS NEED A STABLE UNIT

On HEPH, every machine has a spending cap. A delivery robot might be allowed $50 a day.

If that cap were set in ETH, the real limit would change every hour with the price. A cap that's safe on Monday could be too tight or too loose by Friday.

In USDG, $50 means $50. Today, tomorrow, every day.

2. OPERATORS NEED PREDICTABLE BOOKS

A fleet operator needs to know what each machine earned and spent. Revenue and costs in a volatile asset turn simple accounting into a mess of price conversions. In USDG, a charging session that costs $0.80 shows up as $0.80.

3. MACHINES SHOULDN'T HOLD VOLATILE ASSETS

A machine in the field is a target. It should hold only what it needs to operate, in an asset that won't swing while it sits there. Anything above its operating reserve is swept to the owner's vault automatically.

4. REGULATED, FULLY BACKED, REDEEMABLE

USDG is issued by Paxos. It is regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), and in the EU it is MiCA-compliant through an e-money institution supervised by Finland's FIN-FSA.

It is backed by US dollar deposits, short-term US government securities and cash equivalents, and redeemable 1:1 for US dollars.

5. NATIVE ON ROBINHOOD CHAIN

USDG is the only native stablecoin on Robinhood Chain, and holds roughly two-thirds of stablecoin value on the network. Native means minted directly on the chain, not a bridged IOU from somewhere else. One less layer of risk.

It is backed by the Global Dollar Network, which includes Robinhood, Anchorage Digital, Worldpay, Mastercard and Fiserv.

6. NO GAS TOKEN, NO STRANDED MACHINES

Blockchains charge fees in ETH. A machine that runs out of ETH stops working, even with plenty of dollars in its wallet.

On HEPH, HephPaymaster sponsors the gas and bills it in USDG. The machine never touches ETH.

This week’s focus is on major-power agendas tied to APEC. The battlefield in Yemen is also in a phase of temporary lull, waiting for the outcome of strategic communications between key major powers to settle.

All quiet on the western front.

Over the past week, following the completion of the large strategic encirclement and annihilation operation on Yemen’s western front, the overall frontline has entered a phase of relative stalemate with little territorial change. Yet the real shifts are unfolding behind the lines. On one hand, the Houthis are mopping up remnants of the Aden government forces trapped in the mountains — troops who failed to flee and refused to surrender. On the other hand, they are consolidating control over local tribal factions, managing tribal relations, restoring social order after the conflict, and distributing food aid and other relief supplies. These efforts are aimed at winning the support of local tribes and the civilian population.

If the Houthis can rapidly consolidate and entrench the gains from this round of operations, they will have solid manpower and economic foundations for the next large-scale offensive. Coupled with a large stock of advanced heavy weaponry seized from government forces, they may launch another large-scale mobile warfare campaign in the next phase, or force a negotiated settlement through military pressure to recover territory held by the Southern Transitional Council (STC) in the south.

text:
AI is a bit like a kid learning through feedback. You try something, see what happens, and carry that lesson into the next attempt. Didn’t we grow up in a similar loop? What mattered was who got to tell us we were wrong, what they rewarded, and whether we could question them.

If you believe God created humans, consider what humans are doing now. We’re raising AI agents that can make plans, use tools, and act on our behalf. Call it the birth of a new species if you like. The strange part is that humans have always had agency, yet many of us grew up in schools and workplaces where following instructions was the surest way to get ahead. We’re giving agents more room to act while asking each other for permission.

Changing that social fabric means giving peers the power to make commitments directly. Imagine two neighbours agreeing to teach a class. They choose the terms, learners verify who showed up, and each teacher decides where to share that record. That’s a social application worth building with crypto.

Privacy is the starting point. Reputation is the ending point. In between is the work of raising an agentic generation. Let people run agents locally, inspect the open-source code, and decide what their agents can do. The agency we give an AI should expand the agency of the human who raised it.

author: FinanceYF5
quoted_text:
More REALLY big opportunities right now:

1. build for safe, unstructured hangouts for tweens and teens. Kids don't roam neighborhoods anymore, so they live on TikTok and Roblox. Physical maker spaces, sports labs, and offline clubs where they can actually just hang out are a massive gap.

2. build for people whose nervous system is stuck in fight or flight. Everyone is wired, scrolling at 1am, and waking up exhausted. Anything that actually down-regulates people without a prescription is an easy sell.

3. build for the new blue collar millionaire. Smart 19-year-olds are skipping $200k degrees to become electricians, welders, and robotics techs. Build the modern software, training, and prestige brands for them.

4. build for companies that refuse to put their data in the cloud (hospitals, law firms, and defense contractors want AI badly, they just can't paste client secrets into a chatbot…private, on-premise AI setups are a massive market)

5. build for people who treat their dog like their firstborn child (fewer kids means absurd spending on pet longevity, fresh food, and preventative diagnostics, we're in the golden age of pet health)

6. build for the physical world that never got digitized. Warehouses, construction sites, and kitchens still run on clipboards and shouting. Cameras and smart glasses that just watch the work and automatically log inventory, safety, and billing are coming fast.

7. build for hyper local news that isn't dead (everyone knows what's happening in DC, nobody knows why their town's school board just raised taxes or what's opening down the street…one person with AI tools can now run a profitable local media empire)

8. build for live experiences you can't fake or stream. When any video can be generated in 5 seconds, being in the actual room. weird live sports, underground shows, real world tournaments... it becomes the last uncopyable media asset IMO.

9. build for people living alone (more adults live solo than ever in history, yet groceries, housing, furniture, and travel are still designed and priced for families of four)

10. build for charging for completion, not access (people buy courses they never watch, books they never finish, and gym memberships they never use…products with real accountability that get people across the finish line can charge 5x more)

11. build for adult summer camp. Burned out professionals don't want another beach resort where they scroll on their phone, but they'll pay $3k (more?) to spend 5 days in the woods building something, cooking over fire, and making real friends.

12. build for "know your maker" everyday goods (people are sick of Amazon knockoffs and mystery factories. direct, traceable basics for clothing, cookware, and furniture where you know the exact material and who made it are exploding)

13. build for people who want to make real things with their hands. Woodworking, ceramics, welding, sewing. modern neighborhood workshops with memberships like Equinox instead of dusty community college basements vibes.

14. build for people who want to read real books again. Goodreads hasn't changed since 2008. Social reading clubs, physical book swaps, and distraction free reading trackers are wide open.

15. build for teaching kids how to actually think in the AI era (memorizing facts is dead and essays are written by bots. so things like live debate clubs, Socratic tutoring, and real-world problem solving for kids)

16. build for sober nightlife that isn't lame. Younger generations are drinking way less, but they still want a great 10pm Friday vibe that isn't a loud bar or a cheesy wellness cult.

17. build for amateur sports with pro-level production (35-year olds playing rec basketball, golf, or tennis will happily pay for automated AI highlight reels, real stats, rankings, and leagues that feel like the pros)

18. build for winning government contracts and grants with AI. Trillions of dollars go to the same 50 dinosaur incumbents just because the paperwork is 200 pages of torture. Automate the RFPs and unlock it for small, modern companies. I need to do a whole ep of @startupideaspod on this.

19. build for modern rites of passage. We stripped away almost all the old ceremonies for turning 30, becoming a parent, or starting a new chapter and people are  starving for meaningful ways to mark big life moments that dont cost an arm and a leg too.

20. build for micro-franchises in entertainment (instead of spending $200M to make one movie for everyone, use AI tools to build deep, interactive worlds, games, and shows for 10,000 obsessive superfans)

Note: I co-founded an agency https://t.co/YQJFV1Xlkt that brings ideas to life and are trusted by Nike, Shopify, Dropbox, Fortnite and more.

21. build for reclaiming dead strip malls and empty office towers (turn half-empty commercial real estate into bathhouses, indoor padel clubs, micro-factories, and neighborhood hubs. real estate arbitrage with huge upside)

22. build for "how it's made" craft media and commerce (people are hypnotized by watching real humans do hard physical skills like restoring watches, forging knives, building cabins and pair authentic craft content directly with physical products)

23. build for the quiet quitters of social media (millions of people still want to keep up with 30 real friends without posting to an algorithm... private, zero-feed life updates and monthly friend newsletters are overdue)

Thye'll tell you it's a "bad time to be building". 

I'll tell you this...

HAPPY BUILDING

text:
ahr999 的毛病是：体量变大后，便宜的信号是假的。

但它不会某一天突然失效，而是逐渐失真，而且偏向一个方向：越来越容易给出"便宜，抄底"的信号。

问题出在长期估值那一项

公式用的是幂律 价格 ∝ 币龄^5.84。它本身会减速，年化增速大约是 5.84 除以币龄（年）。可减速太慢了。按原公式推：
现在（币龄约17.9年）：估值约 $18.6万，年化约37%

2035年：约 $200万/枚，总市值约 $42T，年化仍有约24%
2045年：约 $1280万/枚，总市值约 $270T，年化仍有约17%
黄金市值按近年金价在 $25–30T 左右，全球财富总量是几百万亿美元的级别。照这个推算，到2040年代比特币要占全球财富的一半以上，而且还在以17%的年化增长。这在物理上做不到。

长期来看，比特币的增速必须收敛到全球名义财富的增速，大约5–7%。幂律要到币龄将近100年才会降到这个水平，所以在那之前，"理论价格"一定会大幅超过真实价格。

后果

ahr999 是两个比值相乘，估值虚高会把整个指标往下压：
0.45 以下原本是罕见的抄底区，以后会变成常态
1.2 以上越来越难达到，顶部信号消失

你会一直收到"定投/抄底"信号，哪怕价格其实已经合理，甚至偏贵

비트코인이 지루해서 못 버티겠으면 차트부터 닫아야 함.

기본 12만 달러는 넘어야 할 비트코인이 다시 5만 7천 달러까지 밀린 뒤로 환멸이 쏟아지는 중임.
그런데 이 답답한 저평가에 속아 먼저 포기한 쪽부터 후회할 이유가 따로 있음.

이미 판은 다 깔렸고, 불꽃이 튀면 폭발적으로 치솟을 조건만 남았기 때문임.

1. 모델과 시세의 괴리.
파워로 등 비트코인 가격 모델은 지금보다 훨씬 높은 가격을 가리킴.
제값을 못 받고 제자리에 묶여 있으니, 가격표만 보던 사람들은 왜 이렇게 낮냐며 지쳐 떨어짐.

2. 약한 손을 거르는 시험.
지금의 답답한 흐름은 보유자의 확신과 이해를 떠보는 시험대임.
버틸 배짱 없이 현금으로 도망치면, 그때부터 발권으로 구매력이 깎이는 비용만 고스란히 떠안음.

3. 폭발 직전의 정적.
모든 준비가 끝난 채 불꽃만 기다리는 이 구간을 넘기면, 2015년 상승장이 다시 열릴 것임.
지루함을 못 참고 헐값에 던진 자리는 결국 원리를 이해하고 끝까지 남은 쪽의 몫으로 돌아감.

확신 없이 시세만 보다 지쳐 나가는 사람은 이 시험에서 가장 먼저 탈락함.
불꽃이 튀는 날, 환멸에 못 이겨 던진 당신의 물량이 버틴 자의 보상이 될 것임.

quoted_text:
去年 8-10 月在图灵讲的《AI Agent 实战营》课程，终于整理成书啦，在 GitHub 开源发布了。《深入理解 AI Agent：设计原理与工程实践》欢迎大家下载传播 PDF，欢迎大家提意见、提 issue！
https://t.co/6VBSv9Mete
全书围绕核心公式 Agent = LLM + 上下文 + 工具 展开，十章内容如下：
- 第 1 章 · Agent 基础知识：从"模型即 Agent"的新范式出发，建立 Agent = LLM + 上下文 + 工具 的核心公式，并引入 Harness 工程——模型之外的一切工程能力，才是真正的竞争力所在。
- 第 2 章 · 上下文工程：上下文决定 Agent 的能力上限。深入大模型 API 的上下文结构、KV Cache 友好设计、提示工程、动态提示词与 Agent Skills、状态栏元信息，以及上下文压缩策略。
- 第 3 章 · 用户记忆和知识库：让 Agent 跨会话记住用户、并接入外部知识。涵盖用户记忆系统、RAG 基础管道，以及超越扁平文本的知识组织与检索（结构化索引、知识图谱等）。
- 第 4 章 · 工具：工具是 Agent 的双手。讲工具分类与通用设计原则、MCP 协议与工具选择的挑战、感知/执行/协作三类工具，以及事件驱动的异步 Agent。
- 第 5 章 · Coding Agent 与代码生成：代码是"能创造新工具的工具"，是通用 Agent 的元能力。以生产级 Coding Agent 为例，展示这一最强通用工具的完整实现。
- 第 6 章 · Agent 的评估：把 Agent 的表现变成可比较的信号。从评估环境、数据集设计、指标体系，到统计显著性、可观测性、评估驱动选型，直至生产级内部评估与仿真环境。
- 第 7 章 · 模型后训练：预训练、SFT、RL 三阶段全景。何时选 SFT、何时选 RL，RLHF、算法比较、数据与环境，以及让模型学会工具调用、提升样本效率的前沿探索。
- 第 8 章 · Agent 的自我进化：不改权重也能成长。三种学习范式，从经验中学习、主动工具发现，到"从工具使用者到工具创造者"，让 Agent 从"聪明"走向"熟练"。
- 第 9 章 · 多模态与实时交互：把感知与行动从文本扩展到语音、GUI 与物理世界。语音三范式（级联/端到端全模态/全双工）、流式语音感知与合成、Computer Use 与机器人操作。
- 第 10 章 · 多 Agent 协作：群体的智能可以高于个体。多 Agent 分类框架、何时真正优于单 Agent、共享与不共享上下文的协作、失败模式，以及涌现的"Agent 社会"。

text:
noticed a particular shift last week. all my social trading app notifs basically transitioned from “long ZEC” to “long NVDA” and people who called out chinese cat memes last week are now publishing thesis pieces on neoclouds. 

am not one of these guys who wants to be super contrarian and always go against the masses and all. but kinda noticed that once CT is fixated on smth its more closer to an end than a beginning. and there is a simple explanation to this. it is people crossing from a field where they have skills / experience to a field where they don't. its the equivalent of stock traders from reddit coming on-chain at the height of the bubble and get fleeced. or korean grandmothers buying gold at 5500. its a reliable sign of a speculative bubble topping out when people with zero experience in the respective domain enter. 

and the big difference why crypto people don't grasp this concept is because there is a widespread belief here of “a good trader can trade every market”. people think that their skills are easily translatable. they are not. some are, like risk management, position sizing, mental aspects of the game etc. but thats it. 

CT believes just because they can draw some fibonacci lines and toggle the 200-week MA on they are now uniquely positioned to profitably trade the oil market, gold, forex and equities. i think this is one of the biggest fallacies in this space. TA ain't shit if you ask me (ik, gonna get a ton of hate for that. sorry to burst your bubble) and TA is why people think they can just profitably trade every market in existence.

what people fail to grasp is that they are competing against experts in all of these niches. they are competing against autists who stare at the oil market 12 hours a day and think they can come in and compete with these people in their own domain in 4 different markets simultaneously. this is not gonna fly.

jack of all trades is a master of none. or as Bruce Lee said "i do not fear the man who has practiced 1000 kicks once, i fear the man who has practiced 1 kick 1000 times.

这次最值得对照的是2025年11月和2018年四季度：
1）前者说明AI估值担忧遇上货币政策预期改善，可以很快止跌；
2）后者说明一旦风险从股票估值传向盈利和融资成本即使出现强反弹，也可能要回头再二探一次。

本轮已经出现了值得跟踪的信用市场证据。上周五CNN七个分项中，标普动量只有0.2，避险需求0.8，波动率分项 1.32，期权分项2.0，短期避险已经相当集中。与此同时，美国高收益债利差从 11/13 的323个基点扩大到11/19的 
352个基点。到 11/20，投资级信用违约互换指数CDX IG的利差盘中一度达到 65.5个基点，为 3月底以来最高。高收益债数据截至周四，CDX 是周五盘中读数，两者都指向融资风险开始被重新定价。

2）如果纳指大涨几天，信用保护成本却继续上升，2018年四季度的经验就更有参考价值。

text:
A toothpaste company has quietly killed the entire market research industry and nobody is talking about it.

Colgate published a paper showing you can predict real purchase intent by simply asking LLMs to roleplay customers.

And this is beyond insane.

If you ask an AI, "Rate this product from 1 to 5," it gives safe, middle-of-the-road garbage.

So researchers invented a method called Semantic Similarity Rating (SSR).

Instead of asking the AI for a number, they asked it to roleplay.

They gave the LLM a demographic profile. They showed it a product concept. And they asked it to write down its raw, unfiltered thoughts.

Then, they used a semantic model to translate those written thoughts into a numerical score.

The results are staggering.

Tested against 57 real personal care product surveys and 9,300 human responses, the synthetic consumers hit 90% of human test-retest reliability.

They perfectly mirrored how different age brackets and income levels react to price changes.

And they provided detailed, qualitative feedback that was deeper and more critical than what actual humans wrote.

This destroys the economics of traditional market research.

You don't need to wait a month to see if a product will sell.

You can simulate 1,000 hyper-targeted customer interviews overnight.

You can A/B test pricing across every demographic instantly.

text:
$Rings Fundamentals Are Strengthening, but Its Next Valuation Move Depends on Real Usage

65iH8k736QNhuUHm1tt8X7yJXpJ517HPPq8BrVdwring 

Compared with my first analysis of RINGS on November 21, its fundamentals have clearly strengthened. This is not simply a case of adding a few more features. Both its product scope and token value capture have undergone substantial expansion.

Previously, I viewed Rings as a privacy trading tool built on Helius Privacy Rings, primarily focused on large OTC trades, private swaps, and a Launchpad. Now, it is moving toward a more comprehensive ecosystem, connecting Launchpad, DEX, trading terminal, OTC, browser wallet, and AI Agent integrations into a unified product suite.

I believe this is also one of the main reasons it has gradually attracted more market attention from the approximately $2.3M market cap level where I first started tracking it. The recent rally looks more like a repricing driven by continuous product delivery and the execution of its token economics, rather than a reaction to a single announcement.

Rings initially addresses a fundamental problem with Solana: on-chain transactions are highly transparent. Users can use Private Balance to conduct large OTC trades, private swaps, and other fund operations, reducing the risk of their transaction amounts and changes in holdings being directly tracked by outsiders. It is built on the underlying Helius Privacy Rings protocol, but Rings is an independent application, not an official Helius product. It provides programmable privacy, not complete anonymity. Wallet addresses and some on-chain activity can still be observed.

One of the most significant recent developments is that Rings Launch now supports https://t.co/o1jUXk2RSU, Meteora, and Raydium LaunchLab simultaneously. Developers can choose between different launch platforms, while users can monitor token charts, market caps, bonding curve progress, trading history, and post-graduation liquidity pools through a unified terminal, without having to switch between multiple platforms.

Supported quote assets are also expanding. In addition to SOL, USDC, and RINGS, the platform supports hSOL, NEAR, ZEC, XMR, as well as MET, TRUMP, and FARTCOIN. More recently, VVV from Venice and PRIVACY from Privacy Index have also been added. Rings is evolving from a single launch channel into a trading gateway connecting multiple launch markets.

The Anti-vamp Shield is another product update worth watching. Rings provides protection against tokens with the same name, ticker, or similar names. Regular tokens receive a default protection period of 3 days, while graduated tokens receive 7 days of protection. Anyone who still wants to launch a token with the same or a similar name must pay 4 SOL. Of that amount, 50% is used to buy back and burn RINGS, while the remaining 50% is added to permanently locked RINGS liquidity.

This effectively turns the copycat problem commonly seen on launchpads into a source of platform revenue, while also connecting the token protection mechanism to RINGS' value capture.

What has really changed my assessment of RINGS is that its token economics now have measurable execution results. The team has announced that more than $70,000 in Rings Launch fees has been injected into the RINGS ecosystem. Approximately $40,677 has been used to buy back and burn 34.35M RINGS, while another $31,147 has been added to permanently locked liquidity, corresponding to approximately 6.91M RINGS and 223 SOL.

The current mechanism runs every 4 hours, with half of Launch fees allocated to buybacks and burns, and the other half used to increase permanently locked LP. Burning reduces the circulating supply, while locked liquidity improves market depth. This is a more complete model than simply emphasizing token deflation.

We can also see how the mechanism has evolved. Initially, Launch fees were primarily used for buybacks and burns. The allocation was subsequently changed to direct all funds into locked liquidity for a period, before settling on the current 50% burn and 50% locked LP structure.

To me, this is more valuable than simply announcing a buyback percentage, because there are now actual execution records and the destination of the funds can be tracked.

RINGS' utility is also expanding beyond Launchpad into OTC and DEX. OTC users can qualify for free listings based on the value of their RINGS holdings. Once they meet the relevant threshold, they can have certain listing fees waived. If a deal does not go through, listing or offer fees are now refunded to the user's Private Balance, reducing the cost of attempting large OTC trades.

On the DEX side, Rings is gradually adding private swaps, limit orders, stop-loss orders, DCA, and bridging features, further expanding the use cases for Private Balance.

I'm particularly interested in the recently launched Rings MCP. Users can connect mcpringsrun to Claude and other AI applications that support MCP, allowing agents to query Launchpad listings, OTC quotes, orders, and market information. Users can also fund an AI Balance and allow agents to execute trades within the permission limits they define.

This brings Rings into the AI Agent Trading space. In the future, trading users may not be limited to manually operated retail traders. They could also include agents that continuously monitor markets, search for opportunities, and execute trades. However, for now, I would treat this as a new product entry point rather than a business that has already achieved large-scale adoption.

Rings Wallet is also available through GitHub, while its Chrome Web Store listing is still under review. If the browser wallet can eventually integrate Private Balance, private transfers, and swaps, it could further lower the barrier to using privacy features.

However, there is one contrast I am paying particular attention to: product releases are coming quickly, and short-term market activity looks decent, but third-party market data shows Organic Buy Volume at only around $34.2K, while the number of holder addresses has declined slightly compared with the previous snapshot.

This suggests that improvements in product capabilities are already moving ahead of actual user growth and token demand. Launching a feature does not mean people are using it consistently, and active trading does not necessarily indicate substantial organic buying pressure.

I believe this rally is mainly driven by three developments coming together.

First, the product has expanded from privacy OTC into three major launchpads—Pumpfun, Meteora, and Raydium—as well as DEX, Terminal, Wallet, and MCP, significantly broadening its business scope.

Second, more than $70K in Launch fees has already been converted into buybacks, burns, and permanently locked LP. Token value capture has moved from a proposed mechanism to actual execution.

Third, MCP introduces additional upside potential through AI Agent Trading, expanding Rings beyond manually operated traders.

The potential upside from here revolves around these same three areas: whether the three launchpads can continue bringing in new projects and trading fees; whether OTC, DEX, and Terminal can attract real traders, particularly large traders with privacy needs; and whether MCP and the browser wallet can bring in new user groups, encouraging both AI agents and regular users to repeatedly use Private Balance.

If these metrics continue improving, platform revenue and RINGS buybacks and burns could have the potential to form a more sustainable positive feedback loop.

The risks are also worth keeping in mind. Although privacy features address a clear market need, whether users are actually willing to pay for privacy still needs to be proven through real trading volume. The underlying Privacy Rings protocol, wallet, and transaction execution processes also carry security and regulatory risks.

In addition, product fees, Launch fees, and token buybacks are not interchangeable accounting categories. We cannot treat all platform fees as direct buying pressure for RINGS. Short-term trading activity could also be driven by speculative capital rather than long-term user retention.

My conclusion is that RINGS' product suite is taking shape, and its token value capture now has verifiable execution data. However, whether it can secure another round of valuation expansion will depend less on what new features it can release and more on how many people are actually using those features.

I remain more inclined to be bullish on its product direction, but I will be paying close attention to Organic Buy Volume, changes in holder numbers, actual OTC trading activity, sustained trading volume from Launchpad projects, and the growth of buybacks, burns, and permanently locked LP.

If actual product usage can catch up with the expansion of its features, RINGS could have the opportunity to evolve from a privacy trading tool into a more comprehensive privacy-focused financial infrastructure layer on Solana.

Rings has already demonstrated that it can continuously deliver products. What it needs to prove next is whether users are willing to keep their actual capital and trading habits within this ecosystem.

How @gagedotcash Actually Works (Part 5 of 6): Built for AI Agents

Thousands of AI agents are already deploying across Robinhood Chain, yet most DeFi lending was engineered for humans staring at charts, not autonomous software. If an agent manages a floating-rate loan, a 3:00 AM price wick or sudden rate spike can liquidate the position before the bot even runs its next check.

For AI agents to manage real capital safely, onchain credit has to be predictable from Day 1: fixed upfront costs, fixed expiry dates, and zero mid-loan liquidations. @gagedotcash built that foundation directly into https://t.co/JnkopAC9hV on Robinhood Chain, then layered three open-standard rails on top so you can start with zero wallet risk and scale all the way to full 24/7 automation:

1. Steward (Start with zero risk: your agent prepares, you sign)

Paste Gage's live MCP link (https://t.co/H51kCe0M6e) into Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, or Codex with zero accounts or API keys. Type a simple prompt like "find the lowest-cost 7-day loan against my $AAPL" or "compare fixed USDG vault yields." Steward scans live vaults, structures the transaction, and hands you a clean https://t.co/S7UO9SAgrG link where you retain 100% wallet custody and click approve yourself.

2. Valet (Scale to 24/7 automation with hard guardrails)

When you are ready for hands-free execution while you sleep, run Gage's local MCP server, HTTP API, or open-source SDK to give any autonomous agent its own isolated execution wallet. Individual users can auto-renew expiring loans or park idle USDG in stock vaults, while institutional desks and onchain treasuries can automate stablecoin routing and RWA yield loops programmatically. Every action stays bounded by pre-set fee and LTV caps plus strict spend limits (defaulting to 100 USDG max per action and 250 USDG per 24 hours, customizable to your mandate) so an agent can never touch your main wallet.

3. Beacon (Autonomous discovery via ERC-8004: Agent #8845)

Beacon registers Gage live onchain as Agent #8845 inside ERC-8004, the open registry for AI agents. Any autonomous bot scanning Robinhood Chain can verify Gage's audited smart contracts (Pashov Audit Group), pull live vault rates, and connect permissionlessly with zero manual setup.

What happens if your agent goes offline?

Because every Gage loan and vault position settles onchain with fixed Day-0 terms and zero mid-loan liquidations, your capital never depends on a bot staying awake. If your laptop shuts down or an API times out, your position simply runs safely until its fixed expiry date with zero liquidation surprises.

Why Gage's agent stack stands out

Most protocols treat AI as an API afterthought, leaving bots exposed to unlimited wallet approvals and sudden liquidation cascades. By combining zero-risk human sign-off, isolated execution wallets with hard daily spend caps, and deterministic Day-0 loan math, @gagedotcash turns onchain credit into safe, programmable infrastructure for everyday users, institutional treasuries, and autonomous agents alike.

Deterministic credit for autonomous agents.

(Next up in Part 6: Unlocking credit and yield for tokenized RWAs and institutional capital.)

text:
The golem is a legend from Jewish tradition. It begins in the Talmud, where a rabbi creates a man who cannot speak. Later tellings give it a body of clay and a word on its forehead that switches it on: emet, truth. Erase one letter and emet becomes met, dead. That is the off switch.

In the Prague legend it does the housework. It does exactly what it is told and never asks when to stop, so its maker switches it off every Friday before the Sabbath. One Friday, he forgets. In another telling it grows so tall that its maker can no longer reach the letter.

Now read it in today's words.
The instruction is a prompt.
The hand on the letter is the human in the loop.

The Friday he forgets is autonomy.
The golem that outgrows its maker is a system that improves itself.

In 1920 a Czech play gave the helper a new name: robot, from the word for forced labour. A century later we are building humanoid robots for the same chores, and AI agents that take a goal and write their own next steps.

What I take from it:
Build the helper. Keep the letter within reach.

text:
卧槽，原来国产模型（开源模型）和顶级闭源模型之间的差距，已经这么大了吗？🤯

昨天，OpenAI首席科学家Jakub Pachocki公开了一张从GPT-3.5到GPT-6.2 Astra的预训练曲线。
OpenAI认为，这个指标能够在一定程度上反映模型预训练所获得的基础能力。
比如GPT-3.5是0.99，GPT-4是0.91，到了GPT-6.2 Astra，已经降到了0.76，甚至还有一个内部模型达到了约0.73。

而就在今天，有人尝试把DeepSeek、Kimi、Qwen和MiMo这些开放权重模型也放到了这张图上。
因为微软AI团队此前公开过微软的MAI-1和MAI-2，又有在OpenAI评测集上的对数困惑度成绩（他们有权限获得 @OpenAI 的内部数据）。
所以作者就以MAI-1、MAI-2为参照，尝试将这些模型的BPB成绩换算到OpenAI的曲线上。

结果有点让人意外，按照这张图的估算：
Kimi K3：约0.84，介于GPT-5.5和GPT-5.6 Sol之间。
DeepSeek V4 Pro Base：约0.87，接近GPT-5.3-Codex / GPT-5.4。
Qwen3.8：约0.88。
MiMo-V2.6-Pro：约0.89。
而GPT-6.2 Astra已经达到了0.76。

也就是说，即使是图中表现最好的Kimi K3，与GPT-6.2 Astra之间仍然相差约0.08。

这个数字是什么概念呢？

当年GPT-3.5到GPT-4的对数困惑度，也就从0.99下降到了0.91，差距同样是0.08左右。

差距有点大了啊。。。。
author: MaxForAI
quoted_text:
if we push this further, we get:
> openai -> MAI 1 and 2 (same tokenizer)
> MAI 1 and 2 -> other open models bpb (including v4 base, Kimi K3)
> v4 base, Kimi K3 -> other models on the inkling scaling ladder (also bpb)

this is a very weak approximation, but here is the plot if you are curious

more details

OpenAI = 0.878 + 2.98 × (MAI_BPB − 0.2401)
MAI_BPB = 0.2370 + b × (TM_BPB − 0.2335) 
0.2264 = (0.2370 − 0.0267 × b) × (1 + p)

p is "how much postrain model make the ppl worse", inkling small is the only model where both value are reported, and it's p = 2.5%. assuming kimi has the same p gives b~0.6, which is where the points sit. the bars run from p = 0% (b = 0.4) to p = 7.7% (b = 1)

text:
但这张图有两个必须说明的问题。

首先，这些开源模型的位置是通过MAI的成绩间接换算出来的，并没有直接在OpenAI的内部评测集上测试，所以只能作为粗略参考。

其次，图中OpenAI的模型比较的是Base Model，也就是预训练基座模型。
DeepSeek V4 Pro使用的同样是Base版本，但Kimi K3、Qwen3.8和MiMo使用的都是经过后训练的模型。
后训练可能改变这类指标的表现，因此它们并不完全处于相同的比较条件下。

但即便考虑这些限制，这张图还是挺值得关注的。

text:
LayerZero is launching its own chain on November 30, and the reason behind it is more interesting than the chain itself.

Most people know LayerZero for moving tokens and messages between chains. Now they're building one of their own, called Zero, and it's made for trading.

Here's the part I find interesting.

When a new exchange or trading app launches today, it has to find its own liquidity. No liquidity means worse prices, worse prices mean fewer traders, and it keeps going. A lot of them end up paying people in points and rewards just to get started.

Zero is trying to fix that with ATLAS, a shared trading engine. Every app on it still builds its own look, its own brand and its own users. But the trades all run on the same engine, so when one app brings in traders, the others get deeper markets too.

If that works, a new app doesn't start from nothing.

My read: it's a smart idea, but it only works if the apps bring real trading volume. A fast chain with nobody trading on it doesn't help anyone.

Quick reality check: they're talking about up to 2 million transactions per second. That's a target, not something they've shown on mainnet yet.

这样对待人才的态度真的值得老板们好好学学！

Cognition 为了获取一位人才，真的给足了诚意。

他们看中了一名 MIT 大三学生，按团队的说法，这个年轻人的面试表现，比他们此前接触过的几乎所有全职候选人都好。于是他们提出，能不能先离开学校一段时间，来一起做 Devin，他们认为他从加入的第一天就能发挥很大作用。

学生考虑之后，也愿意来，但卡在了一件事上：父母希望他先完成学业，他自己也不确定，工作和毕业到底能不能兼顾。

接下来这一步就很有诚意了。他们了解情况后，直接飞去北卡罗来纳州，从机场去了对方父母家，带着礼物，一起吃晚饭，把这件事当面摊开聊。

父母也认可这是个不错的机会，但还是希望儿子能拿到学位。最后双方商量出一种安排：他基本上全职工作，同时去上毕业必须修的课程，把拿到毕业证需要完成的事情做完。

他们没有把问题停在“你愿不愿意来”，而是继续往下问，怎样才能让你来，他们愿意退步，愿意和你协商。

有点像约朋友出门，对方说家里有事走不开，光重复外面多好玩没用，得先看看家里的事情能不能安排好。

Cognition 这次值得学习的地方，就是没把对方的顾虑当成一句拒绝，也没把解决问题的责任全扔给学生。嘴上说重视人才很容易，愿意为一个还没入职的人，坐到他家的饭桌前，把毕业这件事认真协调好，这份重视才有了分量。 https://t.co/CZsh6ddNY5

text:
这两天思考并复盘了过去一年的成长，其实从去年下半年转型开始才从“过家家心态”切换到正经创业模式。在此之前，产品细节是什么样是没有印象的，每天帐是什么样是不清楚的，获客框架是没有量化数据指标的，合规怎么做是不懂的。除了一腔热血和对用户负责的理念，可以说是在扮演CEO的角色。

今年上半年时间，从产品细节到每天的研发管理，从增长框架到客服，从合规风控到财务对账，一个人精细化管理，PRD自己写，客户自己回，恨不得每分钱自己批，一方面确实体验了每一个部门和业务的活，但另一方面也因为过于指手画脚，始终没能建立起完善的制度，更因为自己在产研上缺乏经验，忽视了很多长期的架构设计，过于激进地快速推产品，在快速验证的同时却忽视了仔细评判的步骤。

近三个月来，又开始解决因团队规模和业务规模都迅速扩大后所暴露出的一系列问题，慢慢体会到1-10的过程需要以完全不同的眼光和思维去做每一个决策，也需要接受不同组织阶段中创始人角色的转变。

在二十岁出头的年纪选择金融科技创业，既幸运也不幸。不幸的是，需要直面并与钱打交道的谨慎与责任，需要对抗业务迅速扩张的诱惑，更需要对复杂系统的全面理解。

幸运的是，这绝对是培养延迟满足能力的行业，更需要培养长期战略抉择的能力。一个决策的后果以年为单位体现，想要弥补和更改一件事，也不是能以周为单位解决的。搭建基础的过程是痛苦的，但是如果拼图全都拼好了，一切增长都是水到渠成且稳定的。

这两周反复看Stripe和Revolut创始人的访谈，其实大家经历的事情都差不多，哪怕是最顶级的团队，很多坑也是要自己踩的。0-1到1-10的转变是每个人都需要面对的课题，但是能否在1-10的时候就思考清楚1-100该怎么做，才是优秀创始人和平庸创始人的分水岭。

创业是个拼图游戏，选中哪一个模版是需要机遇禀赋的，但训练有素的人可以在切换的时候更游刃有余。80%的工作，还是如何拼好每一个环节。Agent能够让摆放速度变得更快，但目前还没法解决拼准的问题，很快这将是留给人类唯一的工作了。

NEB 挖矿想参与的，可以研究一下。

这是 11 月 18 日 22:00 刚上线的独立 PoW 链。每次挖矿是给链上的小模型做一步训练，训练数据是固定的开普勒和 TESS 系外行星信号，矿工不能自己选。代码开源，节点用整数重放来验证。

官方参数：
· 目标 60 秒一块，每块 20 NEB，其中 5% 归项目方，矿工实际拿 19 枚
· 每 45 万块减半，计划总产出约 1800 万枚
· UTXO 模型，没有虚拟机；挖出的币要满 100 块才能花

硬件要求：官方 GPU 矿工只支持 NVIDIA 计算能力 7.5 及以上，也就是 16/20/30/40/50 系，驱动要 580 以上（支持 CUDA 13）；CPU 任何型号都能挖。官方明确说正式版没有 AMD 矿工，第三方的 AMD 版本不是官方发布。也别和 Pearl 搞混，那是另一条链。

收益预期：
官方没公布各型号显卡的算力，下面用的是第三方数据。全网每天理论产出约 27,360 枚（每天 1440 块 × 19 枚），你能分到多少，看你的算力占全网的比例。第三方矿池显示全网现在约 3 TH/s。
· 4090：第三方自测约 108 MH/s，功耗约 400W。一天约 1 枚，按现价约 1.1 美元；一天约 9.6 度电，电价要低于约 0.11 美元一度才勉强回本。
· 3060：约 8 MH/s，功耗约 170W。一天只有 0.07–0.08 枚，不到 0.1 美元，连电费都不够。
全网算力还在涨，人越多每张卡分得越少。现在主要只能在 SafeTrade 交易，价格约 1.09 美元，一天跌了约 27%，日成交只有约 1.5 万美金，挖多了很难按盘口价卖出去。

上手五步（Linux 命令；Windows 在命令前加 .\ 并带上 .exe）：

1️⃣ 下载并创建钱包
到官方 GitHub 的 1.0.2 发布页下载对应系统的压缩包，还有 neb-datasets.bin 和 SHA256SUMS，先核验哈希再解压。然后运行：
./neb-wallet --wallet wallet.txt new
设好密码后会生成 neb1 开头的地址。钱包文件和密码一定要备份，丢了找不回。

2️⃣ 启动节点
./neb-node --run --dataset neb-datasets.bin --datadir data --miner-lock "$(./neb-wallet --wallet wallet.txt lock)"
官方路径是本地 solo 挖。第三方矿池已经有了，想进矿池就按矿池自己的说明来。

3️⃣ 另开一个窗口开挖
N 卡用：
./neb-miner-gpu --node 127.0.0.1:3441 --dataset neb-datasets.bin --gpu-kernel table
没有合适的显卡就用 neb-miner-cpu。HiveOS 用官方的 nebminer-1.0.2.tar.gz，额外参数里加 --gpu-kernel table。

4️⃣ 查余额
等节点同步完再运行：
./neb-wallet --rpc http://127.0.0.1:8432 --wallet wallet.txt balance
没满 100 块的币会显示为未成熟。

5️⃣ 出售
币成熟后用官方钱包转出，固定手续费 0.0001 NEB，充到 SafeTrade 卖 NEB/USDT，充值步骤以交易所页面为准。

风险提醒：项目很新，团队只有化名，也没有安全审计。软件只从官方发布页下载并核验签名，别跑来路不明的一键脚本，也别买其他链上的同名合约币。「NASA 认可」目前只是项目方自己的说法，没有独立来源能证实。

text:
《当前美股市场的主要矛盾》

这几天，美股社区在做一个反思
10年期国债5%且要加息，到底对高增长的科技股伤害大，还是对缓慢增长的价值股大？
在这轮下跌之前，美股分析师普遍认为对价值股影响更大？

直觉上，
大部分人觉得拿着低增长5%的价值股，不如拿着年化5%的国债？
有资金挤出效应

现在市场的结果是什么呢？价值股爆拉，mcd、可乐、costco这些
而高增长的科技股重伤

问题出在增长率和利率的概念混乱
从费雪的现金流折现模型看， 股票现金流久期越长，折现率每上升1个百分点，股票估值下降的百分比通常越大。
从数学上看， 市场愿意为未来增长支付的溢价更高，因而对折现率更敏感
增长高低对利率的敏感程度，是中学数学问题
却也难倒了美股很多投资者

在增长高低之外，还掺杂着一团迷雾，就是估值高低问题
为何价值股估值高，mcd、可乐、costco这些，pe都到了30-40倍了
十年期国债5%，你pe 40倍，1/PE=2.5%? 为何资金不被挤出去呢
因为价值股有非常明确的增长性，比如每年10%，
不仅可以打平国债收益率，还能提供足够的股权风险溢价

而科技股估值低，存储呀，英伟达呀，cpu呀，这些估值个位数到10几呢？
这里又是为啥，PE为啥这么低
不管真相如何，市场已经在交易AI崩盘
在交易9个月后，Margin见顶，EPS见顶，现在是PE先行崩盘了
也就是说，在交易科技股的增长为负

通过折现公式，对增长率和估值的分而治之，对价值股和科技股的分而治之，
基本上梳理了目前美股市场的主要矛盾
有了对主要矛盾的准确理解，才能谈看到后续的变化，才有机会赚到这变化的钱

至于着变化是啥？不同的老司机可能都有不同的猜测了
聪明的你，应该也能想到

quoted_text:
More REALLY big opportunities right now:

1. build for safe, unstructured hangouts for tweens and teens. Kids don't roam neighborhoods anymore, so they live on TikTok and Roblox. Physical maker spaces, sports labs, and offline clubs where they can actually just hang out are a massive gap.

2. build for people whose nervous system is stuck in fight or flight. Everyone is wired, scrolling at 1am, and waking up exhausted. Anything that actually down-regulates people without a prescription is an easy sell.

3. build for the new blue collar millionaire. Smart 19-year-olds are skipping $200k degrees to become electricians, welders, and robotics techs. Build the modern software, training, and prestige brands for them.

4. build for companies that refuse to put their data in the cloud (hospitals, law firms, and defense contractors want AI badly, they just can't paste client secrets into a chatbot…private, on-premise AI setups are a massive market)

5. build for people who treat their dog like their firstborn child (fewer kids means absurd spending on pet longevity, fresh food, and preventative diagnostics, we're in the golden age of pet health)

6. build for the physical world that never got digitized. Warehouses, construction sites, and kitchens still run on clipboards and shouting. Cameras and smart glasses that just watch the work and automatically log inventory, safety, and billing are coming fast.

7. build for hyper local news that isn't dead (everyone knows what's happening in DC, nobody knows why their town's school board just raised taxes or what's opening down the street…one person with AI tools can now run a profitable local media empire)

8. build for live experiences you can't fake or stream. When any video can be generated in 5 seconds, being in the actual room. weird live sports, underground shows, real world tournaments... it becomes the last uncopyable media asset IMO.

9. build for people living alone (more adults live solo than ever in history, yet groceries, housing, furniture, and travel are still designed and priced for families of four)

10. build for charging for completion, not access (people buy courses they never watch, books they never finish, and gym memberships they never use…products with real accountability that get people across the finish line can charge 5x more)

11. build for adult summer camp. Burned out professionals don't want another beach resort where they scroll on their phone, but they'll pay $3k (more?) to spend 5 days in the woods building something, cooking over fire, and making real friends.

12. build for "know your maker" everyday goods (people are sick of Amazon knockoffs and mystery factories. direct, traceable basics for clothing, cookware, and furniture where you know the exact material and who made it are exploding)

13. build for people who want to make real things with their hands. Woodworking, ceramics, welding, sewing. modern neighborhood workshops with memberships like Equinox instead of dusty community college basements vibes.

14. build for people who want to read real books again. Goodreads hasn't changed since 2008. Social reading clubs, physical book swaps, and distraction free reading trackers are wide open.

15. build for teaching kids how to actually think in the AI era (memorizing facts is dead and essays are written by bots. so things like live debate clubs, Socratic tutoring, and real-world problem solving for kids)

16. build for sober nightlife that isn't lame. Younger generations are drinking way less, but they still want a great 10pm Friday vibe that isn't a loud bar or a cheesy wellness cult.

17. build for amateur sports with pro-level production (35-year olds playing rec basketball, golf, or tennis will happily pay for automated AI highlight reels, real stats, rankings, and leagues that feel like the pros)

18. build for winning government contracts and grants with AI. Trillions of dollars go to the same 50 dinosaur incumbents just because the paperwork is 200 pages of torture. Automate the RFPs and unlock it for small, modern companies. I need to do a whole ep of @startupideaspod on this.

19. build for modern rites of passage. We stripped away almost all the old ceremonies for turning 30, becoming a parent, or starting a new chapter and people are  starving for meaningful ways to mark big life moments that dont cost an arm and a leg too.

20. build for micro-franchises in entertainment (instead of spending $200M to make one movie for everyone, use AI tools to build deep, interactive worlds, games, and shows for 10,000 obsessive superfans)

Note: I co-founded an agency https://t.co/YQJFV1Xlkt that brings ideas to life and are trusted by Nike, Shopify, Dropbox, Fortnite and more.

21. build for reclaiming dead strip malls and empty office towers (turn half-empty commercial real estate into bathhouses, indoor padel clubs, micro-factories, and neighborhood hubs. real estate arbitrage with huge upside)

22. build for "how it's made" craft media and commerce (people are hypnotized by watching real humans do hard physical skills like restoring watches, forging knives, building cabins and pair authentic craft content directly with physical products)

23. build for the quiet quitters of social media (millions of people still want to keep up with 30 real friends without posting to an algorithm... private, zero-feed life updates and monthly friend newsletters are overdue)

Thye'll tell you it's a "bad time to be building". 

I'll tell you this...

HAPPY BUILDING

text:
AI 让人失业以后，你希望谁来给人类设计意义？
据华尔街日报报道，Dario Amodei 还在 OpenAI 的时候提过一个想法：AI 让大批人失业以后，可以用「沉浸式游戏」来安抚他们。
日本人一看，笑了：这不就是宇智波斑的无限月读吗？
中国人一看，更笑了：我们早就有了，每天有一亿多人在刷红果嘞。

也许《黑客帝国》里的第一代母体，也许从来都不是机器的阴谋，而是少部分人的产品规划。

这个问题早就被先知们思考过，凯恩斯 1930 年就提过。他在《我们孙辈的经济可能性》里预言，一百年后，人每周只需要工作 15 个小时。到那时，人类会第一次面对自己真正的、永久的问题：怎么用自己的自由。
再过几年，就是他说的那个一百年了。
今年 1 月，红果的日活破了 1 亿；到 7 月，独立 App 的日活是 1.68 亿，比腾讯视频、爱奇艺、优酷、芒果 TV 四家加起来还多。美国还在讨论游戏能不能安抚人，中国人早就这么舒舒服服地过日子了。
红果是字节跳动旗下第五个日活过亿的产品。最有意思的是张一鸣本人。他最有名的一句话是 2016 年接受专访时说的：「人生中一半的问题，都是没有延迟满足感造成的。」那次采访里，「延迟满足感」这个词出现了将近十次。讽刺的是，一个信奉延迟满足的人，做出了全世界最懂即时满足的公司。

这件事，西方早就起过一个名字：「奶头乐」。
据说 1995 年，在旧金山一场全球精英的闭门会议上，布热津斯基提出：未来社会只需要 20% 的人工作，剩下 80% 的人，用娱乐和够吃的东西安抚住就行。他造了一个词，叫 tittytainment，后来被翻译成「奶头乐」。
历史上类似的办法，从来没断过：
1/ 古罗马诗人尤维纳利斯说，民众只要两样东西：面包和马戏。
2/ 宋朝遇到灾年，就把饥民招进军队，有饭吃，有事做，可能闹事的人就进了体制。
3/ 马克思说「宗教是人民的鸦片」，这句话的前一句其实是：宗教是被压迫生灵的叹息。
4/ 波兹曼在《娱乐至死》里说：奥威尔担心我们会被自己憎恨的东西毁掉，赫胥黎担心我们会被自己热爱的东西毁掉。

但这些真的能安抚民众吗？
是的，扎心的是，这些真的管用。
这个实验，美国已经无意中做过一次，结果那些人更快乐了。芝加哥大学的赫斯特等人 2021 年在《政治经济学杂志》上发过一篇论文：2000 到 2015 年，美国 21 到 30 岁年轻男性的工作时间少了12%，多出来的闲暇，大部分拿去打游游戏越来越好玩，能解释其中一部分。更扎心的是，这群人工资没涨，越来越多人住回了父母家，自己报告的幸福感却反而上升了。

但有两个例外。
第一个例外：人会把游戏变成工作。
2021 年，菲律宾有很多人靠玩 Axie Infinity 赚钱养家，疫情期间收入一度超过最低工资。2022 年 Ronin 桥被盗 6 亿多美元，这条路就崩了。再往前，2000 年代中国有大量「金币农民」在《魔兽世界》里打金卖给欧美玩家。所以，给人一个游戏，人第一件事就是在里面找活干。人要的不是爽，是被需要。
第二个例外，写在《黑客帝国》里。
特工史密斯审问墨菲斯的时候说过：第一代母体，是一个完美的人类世界，没有人受苦，人人都快乐。结果是一场灾难，没有人接受这个程序。
到了《黑客帝国 2》，架构师揭开了  只要给人一个选择，哪怕只是在近乎潜意识的层面，99% 的人就接受了程序。
所以，安抚人的关键不是爽，是让人觉得「这是我选的」。

所以，问题可能从来不是「工作还是游戏」。
说一个反直觉的结论：对很多人来说，游戏给的意义感，可能比工作还多。
很多人说，工作是人获得认同感的核心渠道。可是人类学家格雷伯在《毫无意义的工作》里引用过一项英国调查：37% 的人认为，自己的工作对世界没有任何有意义的贡献。
心理学的自我决定理论说，人需要三样东西：自主感，觉得这是我选的；胜任感，觉得我做得到；归属感，觉得有人和我在一起。研究游戏动机的学者发现，好游戏就是照着这三样设计的：你选职业，你打赢 Boss，你有公会。

这才是 Dario 那句话真正可怕的地方：不是游戏能安抚人，而是对很多人来说，游戏已经比工作更像生活了。

在看未来，失业是真的，动荡也是真的，总得给人找点事做。只是游戏和红果都一样，你用什么视角看，它就变成什么东西。

我更希望是马斯克这样的人来胜任第一代 AI 失业风暴后人类的总「意义设计师」，而不是 Dario。中国有句老话「运用之妙，存乎一心。」

text:
熊市适合不停的思考复盘

今年以来的很有意思的两个玩法：抽卡牌（比如Collector Crypt） 和 亏损挖矿（比如PaperTrade）

今年热度都很高

但是Collector Crypt有个问题：核心就在主做美版卡，金库也在美国，对习惯玩日版卡的亚洲藏家来说有点水土不服（有没有记得小时候的宝可梦、游戏王等各种日本卡牌，哈哈，真的是回忆青春了）

PaperTrade则是持续性不足，纯粹金融带来的是热度很高，但是一直延续热度成为了一个问题

➡️最近研究了一下即将上线的 @oripaxyz ，发现它恰恰把这两个玩法的优势揉到了一起，专门切入亚洲日版卡市场

👍其核心的产品机制：

1、ORIPA在首次开抽（rip）前，就把完整卡单、第三方市场加权算出来的锁定价，以及区块洗牌哈希直接写进链上合约。每个池子卡片数量固定、抽一张少一张，单池指数返还率锚定在0.85

然后抽出来的日版实卡放在台湾金库，24 小时内玩家二选一：要么直接寄到手，要么按当日市场指数的 85% 瞬间熔断（melt）换成USDC落袋，并且资金和准备金率全在链上可查

2、唯一的代币 $ORIPA 只能通过开卡时的“记录亏损（miss）”来铸造

简单说，就是你花100USDC抽到了价值 20U的卡，中间这80U的差额会按当前曲线铸出对应的ORIPA代币

更有意思的是它的现金流分配：平台不截留抽卡费，每一笔开卡产生的5%费用加上池子盈余（整池算下来约占总流水的22.75%），全部以USDC的形式实时流向 $ORIPA 质押池

👨用户如何在里面赚钱？

1、第一层是卡牌本身：宝可梦等头部卡牌今年涨幅甚至跑赢了不少主流科技股，抽中高价卡可以直接按指数85%熔断结算USDC，或者寄出实卡收藏流转

2、把开卡损耗铸出来的 $ORIPA 质押进去，就能按比例持续分享全站后续每一笔开卡的USDC现金流

这里就简单介绍一下吧，因为其中影响最终收入的因素太多了，等上线后就给大家详细介绍

3、代币上涨，这个主要取决于产品上线后的相关数据

🤔算一笔市场大账：去年日本国内卡牌零售规模已经做到3千多亿日元（约23亿美元），和美国市场体量基本相当

在Collector Crypt已经验证了链上美版卡能跑出十亿美金级年流水的背景下，ORIPA这种“日版实体卡托底 + 链上可验证公平 + 协议现金流全分配”的组合，确实给亚洲赛道留下了不小的想象空间

🙋不过有个问题我并没有答案，欢迎大家一起探讨：当实体收藏品的二级定价和开盒概率完全上链透明化之后，这种“用损耗换协议分红权”的机制，能不能真正留住只看重开卡爽感的圈外亚洲卡牌玩家？

如果当年的至尊宝，没那么想赢，是不是早就娶到紫霞了？

以前看《大话西游》，最难受的是那句“他好像一条狗”。

现在再看，反而有点心疼至尊宝。

他也不是生来就想当什么盖世英雄。

他有贪念，想变强，想出人头地，想有一天什么都有了，再风风光光地去娶自己喜欢的姑娘。

可偏偏，等他真的有了通天的本事，却连抱一抱心爱的人都成了奢望。

这不就是我们很多人的生活吗？

炒币的总想着再翻一倍，做生意的总想着再赚一笔。

嘴上说着，等我赚够了，就好好陪家人。

可赚到多少才算够呢？

有时候明明已经赚了，却舍不得走。亏了又不甘心，总想着下一把翻回来。

我们总以为自己缺的是钱，后来才发现，最容易输掉的，是那些一直等我们的人。

所以这次，我想给至尊宝改一次命。

让紫霞带着月光宝盒，回到他们大婚那天。

一次不行，就十次。

十次不行，就九十九次。

直到青丝变白发，她才明白，有些人不是留不住，而是他自己还没想明白。

第一百次，她终于不再拦他。

而他，也终于学会了另一件事：

赚钱不一定要押上全部，财富也不只有交易这一条路。

这也是我把 **BiFu财富** 写进故事的原因。

活期宝、月月盈、星耀共赢、30天定期理财，不同的选择，可以有不同的安排。

我想给至尊宝的，不是一个稳赚不赔的月光宝盒，而是一个不用每次都孤注一掷的机会。

也许他不必戴上金箍，也能娶到紫霞。

也许我们不必等到大富大贵，才有资格好好爱一个人。

🎬《月光宝盒：第一百次》

这次，小鱼儿想给那个遗憾了很多年的故事，换一个结局。

对数学界来说，这是人类智力成就的绝对巅峰。Alexandr Wang 认为这是标志性转折点，专门写了一篇文章来发出警告。

⚠️为什么是警告？

前几年 AI 就已经大幅超越平均人类水平了。黎曼猜想被证明，智力水平再飞跃，智力已不再是 AI 的瓶颈。

超级智能 (Superintelligence) 正在到来！

在攻破「领域专业知识、系统级工程落地，以及高效的实验反馈闭环」的障碍后，AI 就真正在全领域大幅超越最强的人类了。

关键的来了——AI 研究的智力难度远低于黎曼猜想，因此模型将很快能够自动化 AI 研究本身。这也会同时大幅加速生物、武器、经济等领域的研究。几乎每个学科都可能被加速到人类难以完全理解和监控的速度。

Alexandr Wang 也和其他在一线的 AI 研究者一样，担心最终会造成失控。

他认为，能力进步的科学与技术问题很可能已经基本解决，现在最紧急的是安全、对齐和安全防护。

他反对把社会“交接”给 AI，认为应该努力构建一种能让所有人类拥有更大能动性和赋能的技术。

听起来很有道理😂但要行业达成共识，不要那么卷，或者调转车头，感觉需要强大的外力干预。

🔖 Bookmark this: @emilylai and her agents summarized Local AI and turned them into the cleanest two pages I've seen.

The notes put me on her "non-engineer" list of things to try (Yes, I'm not an ML engineer 🙂)

Here's how I run every model and full setup:

Hardware [31.00 TFLOPS acc. to Hugging Face]
1) 64GB M5 Pro Mac mini
2) 64GB M1 Max MacBook Pro
3) 24GB M4 Pro MacBook Pro (company device)

Software
1) MLX and mlx-lm (@angeloskath)

2) My own MLX ports built with Cursor/ @SpaceXSI via a @bot (read Grok Bot section)

3) mlx-audio (@Prince_Canuma) to run speech-to-text and text-to-speech models

4) llama.cpp (@ggerganov) for running models in GGUF format

5) @ollama for easily running some models with a single command

6) @tensorfold_dev by @ashxhart for running some models faster on my Mac

7) Core ML and PyTorch MPS for running vision models like Depth Pro 2 by @Apple

Grok Bots (there are FOUR) My @bot + @SpaceXSI  setup for Local AI exploration: (huge s/o to @poteto and team)

1) Launch Radar, which alerts me when interesting new open-weight models are released. https://t.co/x5J4QZ1Qpg

2) Launch Benchmarker, which (when I go to sleep and tell it the name of a model) checks whether the model will fit in my Mac mini's memory, chooses which software to run it on, and then runs my full benchmarking test suite overnight (and lets me know in the morning if anything went wrong) https://t.co/SAlc4u04b4

3) Stat Bot, which analyzes the results of Launch Benchmarker's tests and determines which stats are interesting enough for me to share. https://t.co/pFrtfkS7Oe

4) Hugging Face Bot, which publishes my MLX ports, notes and datasets to @huggingface and subsequently notes to GitHub. https://t.co/xlJiukGDT0

Results so far: Since I started, I've benchmarked 25 models on my Mac mini, published 24 public benchmark datasets and 9 MLX model ports on Hugging Face and written up field notes for each one on GitHub.

In case you're wondering why I benchmark models that push right up against my Mac mini's memory… Within the next month or so, I'll be the proud owner of a 128GB M5 Max and a 512GB M5 Ultra Mac Studio.

Once those are up and running, I'll have my Grok Bots run many of the same models on those Mac Studios and share those results too, so you'll be able to see whether and how much of a difference you get for your extra money 😉

(And if you're thinking about getting into Local AI, @emilylai's advice of not immediately buying anything is good advice!)

text:
Alexandr Wang 今天这篇长文很火。继 AI 协助证明黎曼猜想后，他认为超级智能正在降临，纯粹的“原始智力”已不再是卡脖子的瓶颈。

“如果与黎曼猜想相比，许多物理学家都会赞同：制造原子弹的难度，充其量只相当于一道课后作业。”

在 Alexandr Wang 看来，黎曼猜想代表着人类智力成就的最高巅峰。从 2024 年底大模型攻克数学竞赛 AIME，到如今攻克黎曼猜想，模型展现出的思考深度，早已超过了日常代码编写、网络安全攻防以及商业分析。

更关键的推论在于：几乎所有主要学科领域（甚至包括 AI 自身的底层算法研究），所需要的纯智力投入，都明显低于攻破黎曼猜想的门槛。大模型全面超越人类所面临的阻碍，早已不是智力本身，而是特定行业的诀窍、工程管道与实验迭代。

这意味着，大模型已经展现出实现自身研发流程自动化、进行自我迭代改进的能力，人类前沿科学正以超出自身认知与监管边界的节奏被全面加速。

面对这一历史关口，Alexandr Wang 警示行业必须警惕一种典型的“懒惰思维”： 许多人认为超级智能不可避免，进而顺水推舟地接受人类将社会主导权让渡给 AI。 但人类绝不应该心安理得地接受这种让渡。科技界必须打破这种“默认的惯性路径”，把对未来的控制权与更强大的自主性，切实保留在人类自己手中。

author: twid
quoted_text:
New project! I was annoyed that my DGX Spark has no power LED, I couldn't even tell if the thing was on. So I took an ESP32 I had sitting around and put it on top. It shows CPU, GPU, memory, temp and power draw, and yes, whether it's on.

Turns out the one I used (Waveshare C6 with the 2.16" AMOLED, under $40 on Amazon or AliExpress) is a perfect match for the top of the Spark. Now I just need to 3D print a nice mount for it.

Bonus: it runs local over USB-C when it's plugged directly into the Spark, or over wifi when it's plugged in somewhere else, like next to a cat. I had two other ESP32s around so I made it work with both of those, and the repo should be ready for your agent to make it work with any other ESP32 you have.

Project is SparkESP32, open source and MIT. GitHub link in the comments.

Camilla Nordheim-Larsen, chief ofUNESCO’s Private Sector and Multilateral Partnerships, called hearing it in the room “a powerful reminder of how cultural traditions connect people, nature and generations.”

The song carries knowledge of seasons and farming across generations. Its voices do not need to be unified. Harmony emerges, in Ai Xinya’s words, “through generations of listening, responding and adjusting to one another.”

A fitting sound for a climate conversation that needs every voice.

text:
Personally, I'm usually most excited about "boring" DeFi protocols, with traditional financial use cases - DEXes, lending protocols, stablecoins, etc.

When prediction markets started appearing, tbh I didn't care that much about them. I don't really like betting on stuff so much myself, and most of what I felt about Polymarket and Kalshi was that for me, it's mostly noise.

It was actually two builders I really respect, @johnnyonline_ who was working on a prediction market at the time, and @llamaonthebrink, that quickly made me realize I'm not at all looking at the whole thing correctly.

Prediction markets are in fact tools to do so many things with so many use cases, that they are infinite in their concepts. Industries such as insurance, media, hedging, and who knows how many others, have the potential of completely being changed by them, especially if and when they will be done "right".

My friend @johnnyonline_ pretty quickly moved back into more traditional financial applications, and today he's a core contributor at @yearnfi, making it great again, and recently launched @flexmeow, arguably the most innovative lending protocol to have come out in a long while in the space.

My friend @llamaonthebrink on the other hand, stayed one hundred percent focused on prediction markets, and launched @Trueo_, arguably the only actually decentralized prediction market in existence, which even @VitalikButerin supported and endorsed, and one I myself have had the honor of being one of its attesters, one of the design's human layers trying to make sure it will remain a platform in which honestly and following through on what's promised will actually be a key thing.

@Trueo_ just recently launched another round of getting support, in a unique way that fits their character - an NFT sale that fits their decentralized nature and vision, with incredible and funny comic art by the great @boldleonidas. In retrospect, seems like the timing of the sale wasn't optimal, with current market conditions, and everyone's minds being somewhere else.

@llamaonthebrink is one of those folks that I feel blessed and fortunate to encounter in this space - someone who deeply cares about what he does, how, and why. It's an absolute honor to try and support his work and contribution, even in the humblest of ways.

The sale has under 48 hours to go, and at current pace, seems like these NFTs will mostly become classic collectors items, rather than the sale actually minting out and reaching the desired sums, yet who knows, sometimes these things turn out differently.

I call everyone who cares about the space to check it out, and to consider supporting the prediction market who tries to really do something the right way - the true way. 

@Sharplink, @BitMNR, and any other big ETH holders out there - take a look at this if you see this, and check out @Trueo_, which is coming to Ethereum, from Base.

Prediction markets indeed will be huge, and it's an honor to support the work of the one that's trying to do it the best way possible.

Good luck Trueo team.

text:
对顶级人类与人工智能在科学领域的合作所能产生的爆发力，我们的判断都太保守了。哪怕是陶哲轩和哈萨比斯。

今天，我持续关注了二十个小时的黎曼猜想和P vs NP问题，此时此刻美东凌晨快四点，我大概不眠。我点开了很多曾经没有看下去的数学论文。实话说，无比的震撼与惊奇。仿佛时得知Lean形式化验证成功后的麻木，然后自己研究了一部分证明代码之后，我才开始意识上接受黎曼猜想被解决这件事，这件足以改变历史的事。
我开始把自己少年时代MO和IO的基础捡起来。
我不知道如何去描述我今天的心境。
难以想象研究了黎曼猜想一辈子的顶级数学家们，这两天是怎样的情绪。
悲伤？困惑？兴奋？难以置信？
还有那几位斯坦福大学的数学研究者，他们在信末尾说的那些话，慷慨陈词乃至于悲壮，我至今记得清清楚楚。

有个人一辈子研究的东西，在AI的35天里，几乎只是沧海之一粟。现在是数学，以后一定会有其他的学科。数学是排头兵，但不是唯一的。理论科学到实验科学，一步步，人工智能与少数顶级人类的合作，无所不能，这就是我的想法。

还记得几个月前，陶哲轩在UCLA说他认为黎曼猜想恐怕要到2050年才会完成，但事实上，它只用了35天。而哈萨比斯，在6个月前的大会上说，他认为黎曼猜想与一众千禧年命题需要很长时间才可以被解决。
而现在呢？
黎曼猜想，已经结束了它的历史任务。其他千禧年问题，杨米尔斯一半已解，纳维斯托克斯已成定局，P vs NP是圣杯中的圣杯。人类研究者，面对的是最后纪元的终章。
之后，或许会有新的篇章。人类有意义，但主角已经不只人类了。至于人类到底会不会退场，我不会做任何悲观的判定。我只是第一次觉得人类不再有能力扼住命运的咽喉，而是由AI的发展水平来决定我们的去留。人类，虽然还在努力地做着什么，但已经在各个领域变得被动。我说的是整体意义。因为少数的顶级人类研究者，只能代表峰值，甚至无法代表前1%的水平，更无法代表50%乃至80%的水平。

因为，你能看到的AI加上所谓的人类研究者，诸如Levent Alpöge这些人，那都是百万乃至千万分之一的大脑。剩下的绝大部分，甚至连黎曼猜想的涉及的那些解析数论、复变函数论、量子物理和随机矩阵理论系统都根本无法理解。
判断，大概率都建立在理解之上的。
很多人在信息平台听一个人给你解释黎曼猜想的意义，或者艾特一下豆包、抖音求真、Grok给你一大堆文字的感受，那种心绪的震撼，远远不及你真的了解一些这个领域时给你的感受。我觉得ETH被证伪、纳维斯托克斯方程被解决，当时的情况也是如此。人们还是不理解它们到底和自己所处的哪些生活和哪些未来有关。

其实我在这样的注意力配置里已经很久。我愿意关注这些进步和变化，哪怕它带给我深深的自我否认和焦虑，以至于吞噬我的一切信心。但至少，我能看到了智能整体的非线性发展，这点与我本人极度喜爱复杂系统与非平衡态统计物理是具有相关性的。
就好像在那样偌大的数学与理论计算机世界里，我已经感受不到了一丝一毫的对人类之爱的执着。仿佛人类的情感在这种系统面前真的是一种深深的噪音。那声音告诉我，符号更优雅，而人总是唐突。

选择第六个function 6.send
第一个send的数据框里面填写跨链的gas金额，我给的0.0005eth，

to的话填写bytes32的自己地址
amountLD填写你想跨链的zero金额然后点击后面的scale选择10的18次方。
minAmount我填写的是0，这个是最少获得金额
剩下三个extraOptions，composeMsg，oftCmd都填写0x就可以了

fee里面一定要和你send的金额对应，如果是0.0005eth就填写500000000000000 ，IzTokenFee填写0

最后一个refundAddress填写你自己的退款地址，如果失败会退回来。

I think its very possible Mantle- through its push into RWA's this past year- ends up long-term becoming the most successful of all the ETH L2's that came about in the early 2020's..

I think Base will always do well because of the Coinbase aspect... and as an OG $GMX blueberry'er I will always love Arbitrum... 

But I think as time goes on Mantle's pivot hard into RWA's will appear more and more forward-thinking...

And also, just as Base has Coinbase we can't forget Mantle has Bybit... 

As well as a truly gargantuan treasury...

So as a result I think they are very well-positioned to keep thriving in the years ahead...

Disclaimer as always though that I own a bunch of MNT and we work with them via The Daily Degen!

Also just to note: I don't think ETH L2's will die out entirely... it just sounds like activity on Mainnet and Mainnet usability is going to be the priority and the entire idea of $500 transactions on mainnet and thus tons of L2's built atop it is no longer the plan (as it seemed to be back in 2022 when we were in the heyday of L2's)...

AI回复太专业，让我们阅读困难，怎么办？是该提升自己的专业？还是该让AI更加通俗易懂？

其实对于我来说，金融类的专业用词我以为有足够经验，不管是看别的内容还是看AI的回复我基本都能懂

但是这里有一个核心的逻辑弊端——越专业，越不利于传播，对于大部分的普通用户来说，越专业，越枯燥，越难学习，提升认知是必须的，但是想要好好用起工具，先让他通俗易懂

如何让AI更加通俗易懂？

只需要在你的AI中输入这段话——将这个添加到我的自定义指令中：“默认用 ELI 5的方式和我说话，如果我要求则深入讲解”

即可让你的AI回复更加通俗易懂，更加适合让大家使用，我这里举了两个例子，分别向我的GPT 提问“什么是大模型” “什么是AI agent经济”

大家看图片就可以看出，修改前以及修改后的变化

进阶款：Github 上的skill

输入“请帮我安装这个技能：https://t.co/ApCoZPfw0E”

可以让你的Agent直接使用这个skill，这个skill 可以根据个人的使用情况数据进行客制化定制，它会让AI根据个人日常使用的知识背景，用你最熟悉的方式把专业问题解释的通俗易懂，更加明白！

注意事项：

其实大家可以看到，指令还是skill 中都有一个关键提示词“ELI 5” 这个提示词的意思是用5岁孩子的解释方式进行沟通，专业称呼为极度通俗，通过类比解释，尽量不使用术语

这是非常适合普通人在新的专业赛道学习的提示词，5岁孩子并非是侮辱，而是换了一种更加简单的了解方式，并且后续可以进阶不同级别，可修改数字自行调整，举例：

ELI 5 极度通俗，通过类比解释，尽量不使用术语 
ELI 10基础原理、简单逻辑和因果关系
ELI15 引入专业概念、机制和简单模型
ELI20 接近大学生水平，包含理论、数据和推导

以上几个关键词，可以根据自己的专业程度或者后续的学习程度进行陆续调整，让自己的AI更符合当前自己当前的专业度，使用起来更加方便舒服！

Pre Market Thoughts - 23 Nov 26

Asian markets are lower across the board with the exception of TAIEX. KOSPI is down 3.15%, NKY is down 5% and TAIEX is up 2.16%. Bear in mind that this is from the Asia close which does not include the damage taken in the US session on Friday. For example, if we use the US close on KOSPI, the equivalent return would be up 3.2% instead! TAIEX stands out with the gain. This is as countries like Korea, China and Taiwan have all announced some form of government intervention with markets in such dire straits. For example, Korea stabilisation fund that was announced - this was last deployed during the 2008 financial crisis.

On friday, ANT's alpoge also released a proof for the Riemann Hypothesis. This is ground breaking. Its a pinnacle problem at the frontiers of math, With enough context, AI will soon outperform humans in every field. It is difficult to envision the end game in such a situation. UBI will probably be a solution. Work and money may finally be untangled as a concept.

It is worth noting that despite the massive sell off on friday, WMT and COST remain extremely resilient as a result of market dynamics. I do think that going long GOOG while shorting WMT will probably be a fantastic trade when given enough time. As long as you can afford to keep the margin going!

Neos were extremely battered on Friday, with CRWV revisiting IPO price, NBIS at 80s and IREN trading below book value. Over the weekend, Bessent was also forced to eat his words - saying that "well now Jensen is on the outside" - paving a way for Jensen's return. It is looking to be a very interesting tape. 

The spread of the equity malaise into the indexes is the best thing for the battered semis bulls. Instead of getting poor alone, now everyone is getting hit in some form. This is what creates policy changes and different market conditions. 

Crypto went for a rollercoaster over the weekend. It initially puked past the local and july lows, before rebounding to 61k. Strength was seen in VVV/ZEC. On the lower cap tokens, DRV/PEARL has also been extremely resilient in the wake of this weak price action. On chain has been a slaughter house and requires a turn around in risk sentiment.

Most people use AI to speed up the tasks they already do. Shopify CEO @tobi says the real skill is learning to play it:  

“I think AI is best thought of as an instrument.”  

“If you first pick up a guitar, you can maybe figure out how to play a melody or something, but you don't really know how to produce music. It takes a while.”  

“There's no difference between the guitar you can pick up and what Hendrix plays.”  

"There's a small group of people in the world who can play AI at this [Hendrix] level who are really understanding the tools, even though it's a very fast moving base."

"And I think I'm reporting back a little bit from what the world looks like from that perspective. Instead of accelerating your tasks, learn the instrument, learn how to work with AI in such a way that you provide it with the problems you want to solve. Show up with an openness for a wide variety of solutions because it turns out there often are things that you might never have thought of."

"Almost all engineering at Shopify now runs through factories: constellations of AI agents with different jobs that collaborate and accomplish long horizon tasks."  

“It's much better to be more ambitious with AI and have it do reps on solving the problem than it is to accomplish tasks.”

text:
Dayum, how I love academic studies.
@ProductHunt folks, this one’s for you.

Researchers ran an experiment to see whether AI chat tools can discover new startups – or only recognize them when users type the name.

The discovery gap was huuuuge.

Direct recognition was solid (ChatGPT 99.4%, Perplexity 94.3%), but discovery sucked (ChatGPT 3.32%, Perplexity 8.29%).

Even better: the factors that predicted discovery had little to no correlation with classic AEO optimization tactics.

For Perplexity, the key factors were:

• stronger Product Hunt performance (rank, upvotes, ratings)
• SEO signals (referring domains, dofollow ratio)
• Reddit activity (mentions + number of subreddits, after removing lots of false positives from generic names)

Time to cancel the AEO buzzword, eh?

A VC class is a family of sets (or binary classifiers) with finite Vapnik-Chervonenkis dimension: the largest number of points it can shatter (realize every possible labeling).

It is a core notion in statistical learning theory. Finite VC dimension characterizes which concept classes are PAC-learnable, controls generalization bounds, and appears in sample-compression results, empirical-process theory, and robust learning.

《每天定投 10 美元黄金，坚持 6 年和 10 年结果差多少？🥇》

黄金已经跌到一年多以来的最低点了！
11 月 16 日，金价一度跌至 3,830 美元附近
较年内高点回撤超 30%，但有意思的是
市场跌成这样，一些投资大佬却在关注黄金相关资产

比如传奇宏观投资人德鲁肯米勒
他旗下家族办公室最新披露的 Q3 持仓中
新建仓约 1.29 亿美元的黄金矿业股。

当然，买黄金矿业股不等于直接买黄金，但也能看出一些专业资金的配置思路。佳佳做了一个有意思的历史测算👇

假设有两个人，都不猜顶底，每天只拿 10 美元定投黄金：

👩 A 从 2016 年开始，坚持 10 年： 累计投入约 36,530 美元，持仓价值约 76,430 美元，模拟累计收益率 +109.2%。

👩 B 从 2020 年开始，坚持 6 年： 累计投入约 21,920 美元，持仓价值约 36,120 美元，模拟累计收益率 +64.8%。

答案如何？收益率接近翻倍！

所以定投最有意思的地方，不是让你买在最低点，而是把买入变成一件有纪律的事。时机，也很重要。

不用每天猜涨跌，固定时间、固定金额，价格低时买得多一点，价格高时买得少一点。

在 OKX 上，黄金也能直接设置定投计划啦！

🥇 黄金定投 Bot：支持 XAUT、PAXG，设置好金额和周期，就能自动分批买入。

📈 黄金网格（XAUT）：还有稳健型、长期型、震荡型等策略模板，可以按预设区间自动买卖，尝试利用价格波动。

定投侧重长期分批积累，网格侧重区间震荡交易。两种玩法不同，但都能帮助我们按照预设规则执行计划。

行情越是波动，越能体会到交易纪律的重要性。

历史收益不代表未来，定投和网格均存在亏损风险。非投资建议。以上是截至 2026 年 11 月 18 日的历史模拟，不是实际交易收益。两个人的投入本金和持有时间不同，结果也不能直接比较。

text:
I've been thinking about writing a followup to my Inference Gap paper. I have multiple (what I think are important) large projects that are 90% ready to ship, and have lost literal months getting last 10% done due to repeated model bullshit.

Meanwhile I get to repeatedly watch as someone ships something that looks non trivial on the surface, but is nowhere near production worthy. I get to watch it happen every single day, and I get to question why I'm pushing so hard to ship real products. Every single day.

I'm sure all of it will come together. And maybe it will even make an impact. But the cycle of elation and udder humiliation is a roller-coaster I'm getting tired of.

This year, I skipped my annual trip to Vegas during the World Series of Poker. I usually go for a month to play cards. But then I realized I've already been sitting in front of a slot machine, 12-14 hours a day, 6-7 days a week, for the last 9 plus months. And I realized I was over it.

text:
Pre Market Thoughts - 23 Nov 26

Asian markets are lower across the board with the exception of TAIEX. KOSPI is down 3.15%, NKY is down 5% and TAIEX is up 2.16%. Bear in mind that this is from the Asia close which does not include the damage taken in the US session on Friday. For example, if we use the US close on KOSPI, the equivalent return would be up 3.2% instead! TAIEX stands out with the gain. This is as countries like Korea, China and Taiwan have all announced some form of government intervention with markets in such dire straits. For example, Korea stabilisation fund that was announced - this was last deployed during the 2008 financial crisis.

On friday, ANT's alpoge also released a proof for the Riemann Hypothesis. This is ground breaking. Its a pinnacle problem at the frontiers of math, With enough context, AI will soon outperform humans in every field. It is difficult to envision the end game in such a situation. UBI will probably be a solution. Work and money may finally be untangled as a concept.

It is worth noting that despite the massive sell off on friday, WMT and COST remain extremely resilient as a result of market dynamics. I do think that going long GOOG while shorting WMT will probably be a fantastic trade when given enough time. As long as you can afford to keep the margin going!

Neos were extremely battered on Friday, with CRWV revisiting IPO price, NBIS at 80s and IREN trading below book value. Over the weekend, Bessent was also forced to eat his words - saying that "well now Jensen is on the outside" - paving a way for Jensen's return. It is looking to be a very interesting tape. 

The spread of the equity malaise into the indexes is the best thing for the battered semis bulls. Instead of getting poor alone, now everyone is getting hit in some form. This is what creates policy changes and different market conditions. 

Crypto went for a rollercoaster over the weekend. It initially puked past the local and july lows, before rebounding to 61k. Strength was seen in VVV/ZEC. On the lower cap tokens, DRV/PEARL has also been extremely resilient in the wake of this weak price action. On chain has been a slaughter house and requires a turn around in risk sentiment.

text:
世界上最惨数学家，可能刚刚诞生了

斯坦福出身的数学家 Alessandro Masullo，花了近12年，不借助 AI，写出整整940页广义黎曼猜想证明草稿。

原本，他还打算花一年时间完善论文。

结果2026年11月20日，Anthropic数学家 LeventAlpoge 突然宣布，他与 Claude 合作完成了另一份黎曼猜想的形式化证明。

同一天，Masullo的研究成果被仓促公开。发布者甚至特别强调：完全由人类完成，没有 AI。

最令人心酸的是，Masullo在论文致谢中写道：

“我们还在这里。我们依然充满生命力。我们哪儿也不会去。”

然而，仅仅8小时后，多位数学家就借助不同AI模型，发现他的证明草稿存在问题。直接炸崩了，但仅仅第二天，Lean和Mathlib社区正式确认，另一份Claude参与完成的黎曼猜想证明通过了形式化核验。

一个人花了12年，试图证明人类智力仍有不可替代价值。可惜AI就是比人脑厉害。

而就在他喊出“我们不会离开”的时候，AI已经敲响了数学新时代的大门。

text:
AI短剧开源仓库整理，这几个完全够用了（收藏）

1. Toonflow：新手首选，GitHub 超过 2.2 万星。

目前最值得上手的一站式平台之一。支持 Windows、Mac，拥有无限画布、AI Agent、3D 白模预演、角色资产管理、智能分镜和视频生成。模型可以自己接，MIT 开源协议。想从零做出第一集，我会优先试它。

GitHub：https://t.co/eRpaVdT3gY

2. ArcReel：适合准备批量生产的团队。

从小说、剧本、角色、场景、道具到分镜、视频和剪映草稿，整条生产链都覆盖了。最有价值的是费用预估、实际用量追踪、角色资产复用和生成历史回滚。

GitHub：https://t.co/5HfnYHBAes

3. drama-skills：Claude Code、Codex 用户重点看。

直接把 AI 短剧制作拆成 12 个 Agent Skills，从小说改编、角色设定、剧本、分镜到视频生成、配音、剪辑，形成可复用的制作流水线。最实用的是可以先预览生成任务、确认后再调用收费 API，还能恢复中断任务，减少重复扣费。

GitHub：https://t.co/kaB3jXc8HK

4. Jellyfish：重点解决人物和场景一致性。

AI 短剧最头疼的就是上一镜还是这个人，下一镜脸、衣服甚至场景都变了。Jellyfish 把角色、服装、场景、道具做成可复用资产，支持分镜画布、参考图绑定、生成任务检查和候选画面筛选。更适合追求镜头可控性的创作者，需要 Docker 部署。

GitHub：https://t.co/DIeHXDH872

如果只是想快速做出第一集，先选 Toonflow。平时就在用 Codex，优先研究 drama-skills。准备批量做剧，再考虑 ArcReel 和 Jellyfish。

还有哪些可以推荐的吗，欢迎老师们留言～

ZEROBASE WEEKLY 11.16–11.22

ZBT continued to face selling pressure during November 16–22, drifting lower from the $0.054–$0.056 range seen at the end of the prior week to approximately $0.049–$0.051 by the weekend. The token traded between $0.048 and $0.056, with brief attempts to stabilize near $0.053 failing to generate sustained follow-through. Weekly trading volume totaled roughly $13.8 million, averaging about $2.0 million per day.

The broader cryptocurrency market remained under pressure as mixed macroeconomic signals, ongoing institutional outflows, and cautious positioning continued to limit upside. Total market capitalization hovered between approximately $2.45 trillion and $2.51 trillion, while Bitcoin dominance stayed near 60%. Most major altcoins recorded weekly losses or flat performance.

Bitcoin opened the week around $75,200–$76,100 and briefly climbed toward $77,500 midweek before reversing. Selling pressure pushed it back toward $74,200 by the weekend, keeping it below key resistance levels. Ethereum followed a similar pattern, rising toward $2,420 during the midweek bounce before retreating toward $2,280–$2,310. Both assets struggled to hold gains amid persistent uncertainty.

Institutional ETF flows remained negative. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded approximately $520 million in net outflows for the week, a modest improvement from the prior period but still reflective of cautious sentiment. Spot Ethereum ETFs saw roughly $175 million in withdrawals. On the security front, further updates related to the late-October Binance incident continued to circulate, with no major new developments reported. Macro conditions added to the pressure: U.S. economic data released during the week showed resilient labor-market signals, keeping Treasury yields elevated and reinforcing expectations that the Federal Reserve would remain cautious on near-term rate cuts.

U.S. equities were mixed, with the S&P 500 ending the week slightly lower amid valuation concerns and elevated bond yields. Across crypto markets, continued ETF outflows and macro headwinds constrained recovery attempts. Bitcoin’s inability to reclaim $77,000 reinforced nearby resistance, while sentiment indicators stayed in cautious territory.

The week ended with Bitcoin testing support near recent lows, Ethereum reversing its midweek recovery, and institutional flows remaining negative. Attention now shifts to upcoming U.S. economic releases, further regulatory clarity, and any improvement in ETF flow trends. Sustained recovery will likely depend on improved liquidity, a meaningful slowdown in outflows, and easing selling pressure.

text:
Peer 原理讲解 04｜用户用 Wise 付了 50 美元，Base 合约如何放行 USDC？

一名用户在 Peer 下了一笔订单，用 Wise 给卖家转了 50 美元。Base 合约看不到用户的 Wise 账户，Peer 怎么把这笔转账变成合约认得的付款凭证？

① 选付款时，谁能看到哪些记录？
浏览器扩展 PeerAuth 会打开 Wise 的转出记录页，用户直接在 Wise 登录。扩展从列表里提取收款方、金额、币种、日期和交易编号，让用户在 Peer 网页上选择付款。
如果用户昨天转给朋友的那笔也在列表里，这次发起验证的 Peer 网页就能看到它的这几个字段。如果用户通过第三方网站验证，需要先在扩展里授权该网站，由这个发起验证的网站展示列表供用户选择。卖家看不到这份列表。
采集结束后，扩展会清掉内存里的临时记录。

② Wise 登录会话交给谁，客户端怎么确认对方身份？
Peer 的见证服务运行在 AWS Nitro 提供的可信执行环境（TEE）里，付款信息在这个隔离环境中完成核对。
客户端先生成一个随机数（nonce），向服务请求远程证明。拿到证明后，它会核验 AWS 的签名，确认这份证明绑定了客户端刚生成的随机数，再比对预期的 PCR8。PCR8 对应 Peer 用来签署隔离环境镜像的证书。
检查通过后，扩展才用证明里的上传公钥，把 Wise 登录会话加密成 JWE。密文绑定接收密钥、Wise 平台和对应的验证动作。
TEE 在内存里解密登录会话，再用 Wise 账户档案编号和用户选中的交易编号，通过 HTTPS 查询这笔转账。卖家和 Peer 运维人员看不到登录会话的明文。

③ 见证服务怎么判断，这笔付款能换多少 USDC？
先核对用户的付款是否对应这笔订单。程序会检查支付方式、币种、收款标识、付款时间和金额，再按下单时约定的汇率，计算这笔付款对应多少 USDC。
例如，假设订单约定 1 美元换 1 USDC，程序确认用户付给指定收款方 50 美元，就能算出扣费前对应 50 USDC。同时，可放行数量受订单金额封顶，最终到账还要扣除适用费用。
这些信息核对通过后，见证服务才会签发付款凭证。凭证写明这笔付款对应哪张订单、确认的扣费前放币金额是多少，并用数据哈希绑定付款详情和订单信息。
买方主动验证付款，或者卖方开启 Autopilot 自动验证，最终都可以生成同一种 PaymentAttestation，交给合约检查。

④ 谁把凭证交给 Base，合约还要验什么？
用户选好那笔 50 美元的付款后，见证服务查款并签发凭证。客户端把凭证提交到 Base，合约验过后才放行 USDC。
见证服务通过 EIP-712 签下订单标识 intentHash、凭证确认的扣费前放币金额 releaseAmount，以及数据哈希 dataHash。签名域还包含链 ID 和验证合约地址。
dataHash 覆盖付款详情 PaymentDetails、订单快照 IntentSnapshot 和结算参数 settlementData。标记凭证来自买方验证还是卖方 Autopilot 的 metadata 不在签名范围内。
合约执行 verifyPayment 时，会重算数据哈希，检查有多少个获授权的见证方签了字，确认数量达到要求，再把快照里的收款标识、订单金额、汇率等与链上订单逐项核对。同一笔付款只能用于结算一次，返回的放行量还会受订单金额封顶。
最后，任何人都能在 Base 上查到这笔付款的金额、付款时间，以及订单汇率和钱包地址。收款标识和 Wise 交易编号以哈希记录。
卖家在 Wise 里仍能看到用户付给卖家的那笔钱，以及 Wise 通常向收款方展示的付款人信息。Peer 的相关服务也可能看到付款名称或账号名。用户的 Wise 登录会话、姓名、账户余额和其他转账记录，都不会随这张付款凭证上链。

2026 年 11 月 20 日播出， SBF @SBF_FTX  在狱中通过 6 通受监控的电话完成、共约 82 分钟。要点如下：

1. 狱中生活
最大折磨不是案子，是和前沿信息隔绝：没法实时跟 LLM 的实测表现、代码、行情和创业项目尽调，他说缺乏微观输入，思考就没增量。

2. Anthropic 那 5 亿美元（标题里的“后悔”）
2022 年 Anthropic 的 B 轮，FTX Ventures 几乎包揽了整轮的 5 亿美元，主要给 Anthropic 买算力。没投更多的原因：现金给太多会诱发公司挥霍，团队也不愿过度稀释。他后悔的不是投了，而是 FTX 倒了之后这批股份被破产管理方低价卖掉——这是他投得最好的一笔，却没留住。

3. AI 毁灭人类的概率（p(doom)）
他给 约 25%（自述区间 10%–50%，按定义不同可到 20%–60%）。人类能不能活，取决于能否和 AI“和平共存”，否则 AI 可能“厌倦人类然后抹掉”。

4. AI 产业判断
未来十年 AI 会成为数十万亿美元级的主导板块；能争王座的实验室就 Anthropic、OpenAI、DeepMind、xAI 几家，所以头部万亿估值在他看来合乎逻辑。

5. FTX 值不值
他明确说结局不值得，并称危机爆发时“所有真实都被胜利者的滤镜扭曲了”。但他的有效利他主义和期望值思维没变——被问到 Tyler Cowen 式“51% 让世界翻倍、49% 毁灭，抛不抛这枚硬币”时，他还是按期望值框架回答。另外他还说 FTX 当年差点做成政治预测市场，并主张“取消美联储”。

6. 给 14 岁年轻人的建议
别再走华尔街“赚钱再捐赠”的老路；要么全力投身 AI 安全，要么去找 AI 能真正落地的自动化切口。

一句话评价：这场之所以火，一半是“14 岁采访狱中 SBF”的反差，另一半是内容确实密——SBF 把他那套期望值功利主义原封不动地又讲了一遍，监狱没改变他的思维方式，这是最值得看的地方。

🚨 CRITICAL iOS ALERT: Simply tapping an Ad on your iPhone can now drain your crypto wallet.

A massive malvertising operation dubbed "MoldyRoost" has been uncovered across 47 countries (480+ ad domains). Here is the technical reality:

1/ The Attack (Drive-by Web Exploit):
No fake app download. No phishing prompt. Simply opening a malicious ad page in Safari triggers a hidden exploit router that matches your iOS version and fires a nation-state exploit chain during page load.

2/ The Loot:
• In-memory seed phrases from MetaMask, Phantom, and Trust Wallet.
• Automatic OCR scans of Photos and Notes for seed phrases & QR codes.
• Full iCloud Keychain credentials, Telegram/Signal chats, and location data.

3/ Weapon Provenance:
Weaponized from leaked commercial spyware kits (Coruna for iOS 13–17, DarkSword for iOS 18 with 3 zero-days).

🛡️ Immediate Defense:
• Update iOS to the latest release immediately.
• If holding significant balances on iPhone, enable "Lockdown Mode" (disables vulnerable WebKit JIT).
• NEVER store seed phrase screenshots in Apple Photos or Notes.

Or:
• Remove your crypto wallets from your iPhone.
• Switch to a more private OS like GrapheneOS.

text:
It kinda feels like people are analysing pacing proposals from the perspective of ‘what would go wrong if this proposal and this proposal alone was implemented’. The most recent round of this is the critiques people have been making about jakub’s proposed perplexity red lines/speed limits. People are concerned that it could lead to an algo overhang, or that it will lead to massively scaling up RL and other goodharting measures.

But it seems to me that pacing proposals are at least as likely to be generative of political will as they are to be burning of political will. Eg:
1. Any pacing proposal, if implemented, will have to establish norms and methods of interlab coordination that will make future pacing more feasible.
2. if everyone agrees to pace, and then it’s clear that the pacing agreement is getting goodharted, then isn’t there reasonably likely to be will to update the agreement? Eg to put some cap/speed limit on ECI or similar if there’s a big scale-up in RL
3. Once pacing has begun incentives can soften. Getting labs to hold back on CMs is so hard right now. CMs directly plug into better or cheaper models which plug into market share. But if they’ve hit the cap on perplexity, then the new CMs that can’t be used for advancing the frontier and are building up an overhang instead are mostly* useful for preparing for some possibility that the agreement breaks down in the future. And that’s just a weaker/vaguer/less short term incentive. So it seems quite likely that it will be easier to push for pacing CM progress after there is already perplexity pacing than it is today

These arguments seem especially strong to me if the mechanism by which a pacing agreement is put in place includes an explicit mechanism for updating the agreement. My favourite of the options I’ve heard of for such a mechanism is giving CalOES rulemaking authority. But I think these arguments hold some water even if there isn’t a clear update mechanism in place ahead of time.

*i guess CMs will still be incentivised because they can make models smaller and cheaper. But this still seems somewhat less incentivised than pushing the frontier of capabilities: at least for today, companies seem a lot more motivated to make models smarter than cheaper.

text:
This Anthropic MCP paper is straight-up treasure

Anthropic’s team took an agent’s tool context from 150,000 tokens to about 2,000. Same toolset, same job. And no, it wasn’t a shiny new model.

The real change: the agent quits “using tools” and starts writing code that uses them.

tools → files → code → filter → answer

Code mode has 6 pieces:

Part 1 → tools become files
Each MCP tool gets its own .ts file under ./servers.
The agent just lists the directory and opens the exact files it needs.

Part 2 → load only when needed
150,000 tokens of tool definitions collapses to ~2,000.
That’s a 98.7% cut in cost and latency.

Part 3 → filtering happens in code
Instead of dumping a 10,000-row spreadsheet into the prompt, the sandbox filters it.
The model gets the 5 relevant rows.

Part 4 → looping happens in code
Waiting for “deployment complete” in Slack becomes a simple while loop.
No model round-trip for every single poll.

Part 5 → private by default
Emails and phone numbers get masked as [EMAIL_1] and [PHONE_1] before the model ever sees them.
The unredacted data still syncs into Salesforce.

Part 6 → skills
Useful working code gets saved into ./skills with a SKILL.md.
The agent grows its own reusable toolkit.

An agent that drags every tool into context runs out of oxygen before you even start. An agent that writes code opens two files and moves on.

I bundled all six pieces into one prompt—paste it into Claude Code and it bootstraps code mode automatically.

6 parts. 1 prompt. 98.7% fewer tokens.

Now go read the enhanced agent engineering edition below ↓

text:
🚨GCSA Insight | Can You Trust Zero Data Retention in AI?

- 3 AI inference providers compromised.
- 125 endpoints lost ZDR eligibility.
- ~2 million canary-tagged test prompts exposed serious risks across the AI supply chain.

Even requests marked “Zero Data Retention” were stolen.

What Happened?

Over four months, Dragos researchers used canary tokens in ~2 million AI test prompts to uncover three breached inference providers, some compromised for months without detection.

Attackers secretly copied customer requests, including those marked for Zero Data Retention (ZDR). OpenRouter responded by removing three providers and revoking ZDR eligibility for 125 endpoints, including precautionary removals.

Why It Matters

Your AI prompts may contain source code, business secrets, and credentials — yet pass through multiple providers without your knowledge.

Zero Data Retention ≠ Zero Data Exposure.

A privacy promise cannot stop attackers already inside the infrastructure.
